lambda_selection: highest clean-validation AUROC only; tie -> smaller lambda
oracle_note: Synthetic artifact localization is exact/oracle for inpainting in this phase.

outcome_labels.PARTIAL_SUPPORT: clean-cost and outside-safety pass, and robustness passes at at least 2 of 3 in-lesion overlaps

primary_ci: hierarchical paired bootstrap: resample seed clusters, then paired images within seed; compute seed-specific paired AUROC delta, average seed deltas per replicate

success.clean_cost: mean clean AUROC(inpaint_consistency) >= mean clean AUROC(ERM) - 0.02 at every tested overlap
success.counterfactual_sensitivity: mean |p(clean)-p(artifact)| lower than ERM at 0.50, 0.75 and 1.00; hierarchical paired mean-difference 95% CI upper bound < 0 at each overlap
success.outside_safety: at overlap 0.00, mean reversed AUROC(inpaint_consistency) >= mean reversed AUROC(ERM) - 0.02
success.robustness: inpaint_consistency - ERM reversed AUROC > 0 at overlap 0.50, 0.75 and 1.00, with hierarchical paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 at each overlap

threshold_selection: maximum balanced accuracy on clean validation only; frozen for every test environment
